name: Clicking a citation marker scrolls to or highlights the corresponding reference
description: When a reader clicks an inline citation marker like [1] in the analysis text, the page should scroll to or highlight the corresponding numbered entry in the references panel.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket cell to open a match detail page
Locate and click the first inline citation marker visible in the analysis text (such as [1] or a superscript number)

Verify that the page responds to the click by scrolling to the references section or by highlighting/focusing the corresponding reference entry. The references section should be visible in the viewport after the click.
